_comment: Canonical document names. A scheme's documents[] may only use ids from this list, so the checklist screen can de-duplicate across schemes ('these 5 documents unlock 12 schemes'). Add an id here before using it in a scheme file.

documents.label: Aadhaar card
documents.note: The card is shown at the office or uploaded to the official portal. We never ask for or store the number.
documents.where_to_get: Any Aadhaar Seva Kendra, or download from uidai.gov.in

documents.label: Bank passbook or account details
documents.note: The account must be in the applicant's own name for a direct transfer to arrive.

documents.label: Land record (chitta / adangal / patta)
documents.note: Must show the land in the applicant's name.

documents.label: Income certificate
documents.note: Usually valid for one year. An expired certificate is the most common reason an application is returned.

documents.label: Proof of address
documents.where_to_get: e-Sevai centre, or any accepted utility bill

documents.label: A mobile number you can receive OTPs on
documents.note: Needed for eKYC on most central portals.

documents.label: Deprivation declaration
documents.note: A self-declaration in the prescribed format. Filled in at the LPG distributor, not obtained beforehand.

documents.label: Certificate of Vending, ULB identity card, or Letter of Recommendation
documents.note: Issued by the Town Vending Committee or Urban Local Body in towns, or by the Block Development Office in census towns and peri-urban areas.
documents.where_to_get: Your Urban Local Body, or the Block Development Office

documents.label: Birth certificate
documents.where_to_get: Municipal corporation, or the town or village panchayat

documents.label: Sterilisation certificate
documents.where_to_get: The government hospital or primary health centre that performed it

documents.label: Death certificate of the spouse
documents.where_to_get: Municipal corporation, or the town or village panchayat

documents.label: Disability certificate
documents.note: States the assessed percentage. Issued by a government medical board.
documents.where_to_get: District Differently Abled Welfare Office, or a government medical board

documents.label: Class 12 marksheet
documents.where_to_get: Your school, or your board's results portal

documents.label: Bonafide certificate from your college
documents.note: Confirms you are currently enrolled. Some schemes need it renewed twice a year.
